steps.title: Copy the Composio callback URL
steps.detail: In Composio: Authentication management → Create Auth Config → Slack → OAuth2 → Use your own developer credentials. The redirect URI is https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback.

steps.title: Create a Slack app
steps.detail: At api.slack.com/apps → Create New App → From scratch. Name it (users see this on the consent screen) and pick a development workspace.

steps.title: Add the redirect URL and scopes
steps.detail: OAuth & Permissions → Redirect URLs: add the Composio callback (HTTPS, no #). Add the bot/user scopes your agent needs, e.g. channels:history, chat:write.

steps.title: Paste the client ID and secret into Composio
steps.detail: Basic Information → App Credentials: copy Client ID and Client Secret into the Composio auth config.

steps.title: Connect your workspace and run one tool
steps.detail: Connect through the new auth config, check the consent screen shows your app's name, and run one Slack tool.

steps.title: Activate public distribution
steps.detail: Manage Distribution → complete the checklist (remove hard-coded secrets, HTTPS redirect) → Activate Public Distribution. Now any workspace can install it.

steps.title: Submit to the Slack Marketplace (to lift the history limit)
steps.detail: Once 10 or more workspaces actively use the app, submit it. History, file and admin scopes get an enhanced review; prepare a clear justification for each scope.

blockers.workaround: Grow installs on public distribution first; posting isn't limited meanwhile

steps.title: Marketplace review
steps.detail: Up to 10 business days for preliminary feedback, then up to 10 weeks of functional review.
